reason: As someone wary of health promises, B earns more of my trust: it admits the 14 people chose to share, that it isn't a study and that medication changes weren't tracked, then promises only what it can control (dietitian-planned meals at or under 45 g of carbs). A is honest too, but it leaves out the medication gap and words the 0.6-point drop as if it applied to the ten who improved, which reads slightly more like a pitch.
